      <p>The datasets come from different institutions, dates, methods and spatial resolutions. They form a layered evidence base rather than a single authoritative dataset. Borderland Districts use the finest named district geography available in the source and fall back to the next available district level where necessary. Persistent violence records whether at least one included ACLED event occurred in each of the five August-aligned observation periods covering 1 August 2020–1 August 2025. Violence displays include actual recorded totals and population-adjusted rates. The rates divide the five-period totals by five and express the annual average per 10,000 WorldPop-estimated residents; they are rates, not event counts, and can remain volatile where estimated populations are very small.</p>
